pt.B: Eles foram a Hilquias, o sumo sacerdote, e lhe entregaram o dinheiro trazido à casa de Deus, que os levitas que guardavam as portas tinham recolhido de Manassés e de Efraim, de todo o restante de Israel e de todo o Judá e Benjamim. Depois voltaram para Jerusalém.
pt.R: Eles foram até Hilquias, o sumo sacerdote, e lhe entregaram o dinheiro que as pessoas tinham trazido ao templo de Deus. Os levitas que guardavam a entrada tinham recolhido esse dinheiro do povo de Manassés e de Efraim, de todos os que tinham ficado em Israel e de todo o povo de Judá e de Benjamim. Depois voltaram para Jerusalém.

am.L: ወደ ሊቀ ካህናቱም ወደ ኬልቅያስ መጡ፤ የደጃፉ ጠባቂዎች ሌዋውያን ከምናሴና ከኤፍሬም እጅ፣ ከእስራኤልም ቅሬታ ሁሉ፣ ከይሁዳና ከብንያምም ሁሉ የሰበሰቡትን፣ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት የገባውን ገንዘብ ሰጡ፤ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ተመለሱ።
am.B: ወደ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ወደ ኬልቅያስ መጥተው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ የገባውን ገንዘብ አስረከቡት፤ ይህን ገንዘብ በር ጠባቂዎቹ ሌዋውያን ከምናሴና ከኤፍሬም፣ ከቀሩት እስራኤላውያን ሁሉ፣ ከይሁዳና ከብንያምም ሁሉ ሰብስበውት ነበር፤ ከዚያም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ።
am.R: ወደ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ወደ ኬልቅያስ ሄደው ሕዝቡ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ ያመጡትን ገንዘብ ሰጡት። መግቢያውን የሚጠብቁት ሌዋውያን ይህን ገንዘብ ከምናሴና ከኤፍሬም ሕዝብ፣ በእስራኤል ከቀሩት ሁሉ፣ ከይሁዳና ከብንያም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ሰብስበውት ነበር። ከዚያም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ።

hi.L: और वे महायाजक हिल्किय्याह के पास आए और उस रुपये को दिया जो परमेश्वर के भवन में लाया गया था, जिसे डेवढ़ी के रखवाले लेवियों ने मनश्शे और एप्रैम के हाथ से, और इस्राएल के सब बचे हुओं से, और सारे यहूदा और बिन्यामीन से इकट्ठा किया था; और वे यरूशलेम को लौटे।
hi.B: वे महायाजक हिल्किय्याह के पास आए और वह रुपया सौंप दिया जो परमेश्वर के भवन में लाया गया था, जिसे द्वारपाल लेवियों ने मनश्शे और एप्रैम से, इस्राएल के सब बचे हुए लोगों से, और सारे यहूदा और बिन्यामीन से इकट्ठा किया था। और वे यरूशलेम लौट आए।
hi.R: वे महायाजक हिल्किय्याह के पास गए और उसे वह रुपया सौंप दिया जो लोग परमेश्वर के भवन में लाए थे। प्रवेश-द्वार की रखवाली करनेवाले लेवियों ने उसे मनश्शे और एप्रैम के लोगों से, इस्राएल में बचे हुए सब लोगों से, और यहूदा और बिन्यामीन के सब लोगों से इकट्ठा किया था। फिर वे यरूशलेम लौट आए।

ru.L: И пришли они к Хелкии, первосвященнику, и отдали серебро, принесённое [в] дом Божий, которое собрали левиты, стерегущие порог, от руки Манассии и Ефрема, и от всего остатка Израиля, и от всего Иуды и Вениамина; и вернулись [в] Иерусалим.
ru.B: Они пришли к первосвященнику Хелкии и передали деньги, принесённые в дом Божий, которые левиты-привратники собрали с Манассии и Ефрема, со всего остального Израиля и со всего Иуды и Вениамина, и вернулись в Иерусалим.
ru.R: Они пошли к первосвященнику Хелкии и отдали ему деньги, которые люди принесли в Божий храм. Их собрали левиты, которые охраняли вход, у народа Манассии и Ефрема, у всех, кто остался в Израиле, и у всего народа Иуды и Вениамина. Потом они вернулись в Иерусалим.

ja.L: そして彼らは大祭司ヒルキヤのもとに来て、神の家に持ち込まれた銀を渡した。それは、敷居を守る者たちであるレビ人たちが、マナセとエフライムの手から、イスラエルのすべての残りの者から、またすべてのユダとベニヤミンから集めたものである。そして彼らはエルサレムに帰った。
ja.B: 彼らは大祭司ヒルキヤのもとに行き、神の家に納められた銀を渡した。それは、入り口を守るレビ人たちが、マナセとエフライムから、イスラエルのほかのすべての残りの者から、またユダとベニヤミンのすべての人々から集めたものであった。そして彼らはエルサレムに帰った。
ja.R: 彼らは大祭司ヒルキヤのところへ行き、人々が神の神殿に持って来たお金を渡しました。そのお金は、入り口の番をしているレビ人たちが、マナセとエフライムの人々や、イスラエルに残っているほかのすべての人々、そしてユダとベニヤミンのすべての人々から集めたものでした。それから、彼らはエルサレムに帰って来ました。

uk.L: І прийшли вони до Хілкії, первосвященника, і віддали срібло, принесене [до] дому Божого, яке левити, сторожі порога, зібрали з руки Манасії, і Єфрема, і з усього залишку Ізраїля, і з усієї Юди та Веніямина; і повернулися [до] Єрусалима.
uk.B: Вони прийшли до первосвященника Хілкії і передали срібло, принесене до дому Божого, яке левити, що стерегли двері, зібрали з Манасії та Єфрема, з усього залишку Ізраїля і з усієї Юди та Веніямина, і повернулися до Єрусалима.
uk.R: Вони пішли до первосвященника Хілкії і передали йому срібло, яке люди принесли до Божого храму. Левити, що стерегли вхід, зібрали його від людей Манасії та Єфрема, від усіх інших, хто залишився в Ізраїлі, і від усього народу Юди та Веніямина. Потім вони повернулися до Єрусалима.

decisions.choice: the money the Levites collected: as in 2 Kings 22:4
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 22:4 speaks of the money "the keepers of the threshold have gathered from the people". Chronicles names these doorkeepers as Levites and says that the gifts came from the north, from Manasseh, Ephraim and the rest of Israel, as well as from Judah and Benjamin: the whole people shared in repairing the house of God, as under Joash (24:5-11).

decisions.choice: the remnant of Israel: those left in the north
decisions.reason: The "remnant" are the Israelites who remained in the land of the northern tribes after the Assyrian conquest (30:6; 2 Kings 17:6).

decisions.choice: and they returned to Jerusalem: the reading in the margin
alternatives: and from the inhabitants of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The letters written in the Hebrew text read "and the inhabitants of Jerusalem", which would add Jerusalem to the list of those who gave. The margin reads, with the same letters differently arranged, "and they returned to Jerusalem", followed here: the Levites who had gone out to collect the money came back to the city. Either reading is possible.

decisions.choice: Hilkiah the high priest
decisions.reason: Literally "the great priest", the title of the chief priest, as in 2 Kings 22:4.

decisions.choice: the Levites who kept the doors (Balanced); the Levites who guarded the entrance (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the duty that "keepers of the threshold" stands for, as 2 Kings 22:4 does; Literal keeps the picture. Readable says "God's temple" for "the house of God".

decisions.choice: "los guardianes del umbral" (L); "los porteros" (B); "que cuidaban la entrada" (R)
decisions.reason: As Spanish 2 Kings 22:4 words the threshold keepers at each level.

decisions.choice: "gardiens du seuil" (Literal); "gardiens de l'entrée" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording of French 2 Kings 22:4 for the same office.

decisions.choice: Hilquias, o sumo sacerdote; os levitas, guardas da soleira (L), que guardavam as portas (B), que guardavam a entrada (R); o dinheiro (every level)
decisions.reason: "Hilquias, o sumo sacerdote" (m4) and "os guardas da soleira" (L) as 2 Kings 22:4 in Portuguese, with Chronicles naming them as Levites (m1); Balanced and Readable say what they did, as the English does. "Dinheiro" at every level, as the English says "money" at Literal here.

decisions.choice: The keepers of the threshold are "የደጃፉ ጠባቂዎች" (Literal), "በር ጠባቂዎች" (Balanced), "መግቢያውን የሚጠብቁት" (Readable), as in 2 Kings 22:4; "the house of God" is "የእግዚአብሔር ቤት" with no divine_name span.
decisions.reason: Chronicles says Elohim here, so the Amharic has plain "እግዚአብሔር"; it also names the Levites and the givers, which Kings does not.

decisions.choice: "डेवढ़ी के रखवाले" (L); "द्वारपाल" (B); "प्रवेश-द्वार की रखवाली करनेवाले" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 22:4 at each level for the keepers of the threshold.

decisions.choice: shomrei hassaf "敷居を守る者たち" (L), "入り口を守る" (B), "入り口の番をしている" (R); kesef "銀" (L, B), "お金" (R), as 2 Kings 22:4.
decisions.reason: The 2 Kings 22 forms.

source.text: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ עַל־יַד֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה הַמֻּפְקָדִ֖ים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ עוֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹשִׂים֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לִבְדּ֥וֹק וּלְחַזֵּ֖ק הַבָּֽיִת׃

records.literal_gloss: And they gave [it] on [the] hand of [the] doer of the work, those appointed in [the] house of Yahweh; and they gave it [to the] doers of the work who [were] working in [the] house of Yahweh, to mend and to repair the house.

en.L: And they gave [it] into the hand of the doers of the work, who were appointed in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and they gave it [to] the doers of the work who were working in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to mend and to repair the house.
en.B: They handed it to the men doing the work, who had been put in charge of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they paid it to the workmen in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to mend and repair the house.
en.R: Then they gave it to the men who had been put in charge of the work on the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. These men used it to pay the workers who were mending and repairing the temple.

es.L: Y [lo] entregaron en mano de los que hacían la obra, los encargados en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; y ellos lo dieron [a] los que hacían la obra que trabajaban en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para reparar y restaurar la casa.
es.B: Se lo entregaron a los que hacían la obra, los que habían sido puestos a cargo de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y estos se lo pagaron a los obreros que trabajaban en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para reparar y restaurar la casa.
es.R: Luego se lo dieron a los hombres encargados de la obra del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Ellos lo usaron para pagar a los trabajadores que estaban reparando y restaurando el templo.

fr.L: Et ils le remirent entre les mains de ceux qui faisaient l’ouvrage, qui étaient préposés à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; et ceux-ci le donnèrent [à] ceux qui faisaient l’ouvrage et travaillaient dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour réparer et remettre en état la maison.
fr.B: Ils le remirent aux responsables des travaux, chargés de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et ceux-ci en payèrent les ouvriers qui travaillaient dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour la réparer et la remettre en état.
fr.R: Ensuite ils l’ont donné aux hommes chargés des travaux du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Ces hommes s’en sont servis pour payer les ouvriers qui réparaient et remettaient en état le temple.

sw.L: Wakaitia katika mkono wa watendaji wa kazi, walioteuliwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; nao wakaitoa kwa watendaji wa kazi waliofanya kazi katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili kuitengeneza na kuikarabati nyumba.
sw.B: Waliikabidhi kwa watu wanaofanya kazi, waliowekwa kuisimamia nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nao wakawalipa mafundi waliofanya kazi katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ili kuitengeneza na kuikarabati nyumba.
sw.R: Kisha wakawapa watu waliowekwa kusimamia kazi ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Watu hao waliitumia kuwalipa wafanyakazi waliokuwa wakilitengeneza na kulikarabati hekalu.

vi.L: Họ giao [bạc] vào tay những người làm công việc, là những người được đặt coi sóc nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; và những người ấy giao nó cho những người làm công việc trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để tu bổ và sửa chữa nhà.
vi.B: Họ giao bạc cho những người phụ trách công việc, là những người được giao coi sóc nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và những người này trả cho các thợ đang làm việc trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để tu bổ và sửa chữa nhà.
vi.R: Rồi họ giao bạc cho những người được giao trông coi công việc ở đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Những người này dùng bạc ấy trả công cho các thợ đang tu bổ và sửa chữa đền thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그것을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 임명된, 일하는 자들의 손에 주었다. 그리고 그들이 그것을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 일하는 자들에게 주어 그 집을 보수하고 수리하게 했다.
ko.B: 그들은 그 돈을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 공사를 맡은 감독들에게 넘겨주었고, 감독들은 그 돈을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 일하는 일꾼들에게 주어 성전을 보수하고 수리하게 했다.
ko.R: 그런 다음 그들은 그 돈을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 공사를 맡은 감독들에게 주었다. 감독들은 그 돈으로 성전을 보수하고 수리하는 일꾼들에게 품삯을 주었다.

pt.L: E [o] deram na mão dos que faziam o trabalho, os encarregados na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; e eles o deram [aos] que faziam o trabalho, que trabalhavam na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, para consertar e reparar a casa.
pt.B: Eles o entregaram aos que faziam o trabalho, os homens encarregados da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e estes o pagaram aos trabalhadores da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, para consertar e reparar a casa.
pt.R: Depois eles o entregaram aos homens encarregados da obra do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Esses homens o usaram para pagar os trabalhadores que estavam consertando e reparando o templo.

am.L: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤት ላይ በተሾሙት በሥራው ሠሪዎች እጅ ሰጡት፤ እነርሱም {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤት ለሚሠሩት ለሥራው ሠሪዎች ቤቱን ይጠግኑና ያድሱ ዘንድ ሰጡት።
am.B: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ሥራ ላይ ለተሾሙት ሰዎች አስረከቡት። እነዚህም ቤቱን እንዲጠግኑና እንዲያድሱ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ለሚሠሩት ሠራተኞች ከፈሏቸው።
am.R: ከዚያም {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ሥራ ላይ ኃላፊዎች ለሆኑት ሰዎች ሰጡት። እነዚህ ሰዎችም ቤተ መቅደሱን ለሚጠግኑትና ለሚያድሱት ሠራተኞች ከፈሉበት።

hi.L: और उन्होंने [उसे] काम करनेवालों के हाथ में दिया, जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन पर ठहराए गए थे; और उन्होंने उसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में काम करनेवालों को दिया, कि भवन की दरारों की मरम्मत करें और उसे सुधारें।
hi.B: उन्होंने उसे उन लोगों को सौंप दिया जिन्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन के काम पर ठहराया गया था, और उन्होंने उसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन के उन कारीगरों को दिया जो भवन की टूट-फूट की मरम्मत और सुधार कर रहे थे।
hi.R: फिर उन्होंने उसे उन लोगों को दिया जिन्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन के काम की देख-रेख सौंपी गई थी। इन लोगों ने उससे उन मज़दूरों को मज़दूरी दी जो भवन की मरम्मत और सुधार कर रहे थे।

ru.L: И отдали они [его] в руку исполнителей работы, поставленных в доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}; и те отдали его исполнителям работы, которые работали в доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, чтобы чинить и исправлять дом.
ru.B: Они передали их тем, кто вёл работы и был поставлен над домом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, а те платили работникам в доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, чтобы они чинили и исправляли дом.
ru.R: Потом они отдали их тем, кому было поручено руководить работами в храме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Эти люди платили работникам, которые чинили и восстанавливали храм.

ja.L: そして彼らは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家で任命されている、工事をする者たちの手に[それを]渡した。そして彼らは、家を繕い修理するために、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家で働いている、工事をする者たちにそれを渡した。
ja.B: 彼らはそれを、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家の工事を任されている者たちに渡した。その者たちは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家で働き、神殿を繕い修理している者たちに、それを支払った。
ja.R: それから彼らは、そのお金を、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿の工事を任されている人たちに渡しました。その人たちは、そのお金で、神殿を直したり修理したりしている働き手たちに支払いをしました。

uk.L: І дали [його] в руку тих, що виконували роботу, поставлених у домі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОМУ|Ягве}}; і ті дали його тим, що виконували роботу, які працювали в домі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОМУ|Ягве}}, щоб лагодити й відновлювати дім.
uk.B: Вони передали його тим, хто виконував роботу і був поставлений над домом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНІМ|Ягве}}, а ті платили ним робітникам у домі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОМУ|Ягве}}, щоб лагодити й відновлювати дім.
uk.R: Потім вони віддали його людям, яких поставили наглядати за роботою в храмі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОМУ|Ягве}}. Ці люди платили ним робітникам, які лагодили й відновлювали храм.

decisions.choice: the money handed to the overseers and the workmen: 2 Kings 22:5 carried out
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 22:5 gives the king's orders in nearly these words: let them give it to the men appointed over the work, and let them give it to the workmen to repair the house. Chronicles tells it as done. It says "to mend and to repair" where Kings says "to repair the breach of the house".

decisions.choice: they gave it to the workmen: the overseers paid the workers
alternatives: and the workmen in the house of Yahweh spent it to mend and repair the house
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 22:5, "the doers of the work" names first the overseers and then the workmen they paid. The second time the Hebrew has no "to", and the words can also be read "and the workmen who were working in the house gave it", that is, spent it on the repairs. The meaning is the same: the money went to the work.

decisions.choice: the doers of the work, who were appointed in the house of the LORD / the men doing the work, who had been put in charge of the house of the LORD
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 22:5 where the Hebrew is the same. Literal brackets the "to" that the second clause lacks (m2).

decisions.choice: os que faziam o trabalho, os encarregados na casa do SENHOR (L), os homens encarregados da casa do SENHOR (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words of 2 Kings 22:5 in Portuguese where the Hebrew is the same (m1), told as done, in the past; Chronicles' "consertar e reparar" for Kings' "reparar a brecha". Literal brackets the "aos" the second clause lacks (m2).

decisions.choice: The wording of 2 Kings 22:5 ("{{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤት ላይ በተሾሙት በሥራው ሠሪዎች እጅ"), told as done ("ሰጡት") where Kings gives the order ("ይስጡት"), with "ይጠግኑና ያድሱ" (mend and repair).
decisions.reason: Chronicles narrates the carrying out of the order of 2 Kings 22:5 and has two verbs for the repair.

source.text: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ לֶחָֽרָשִׁים֙ וְלַבֹּנִ֔ים לִקְנוֹת֙ אַבְנֵ֣י מַחְצֵ֔ב וְעֵצִ֖ים לַֽמְחַבְּר֑וֹת וּלְקָרוֹת֙ אֶת־הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁחִ֖יתוּ מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they gave [it] to the craftsmen and to the builders, to buy stones of hewing and timbers for the couplings, and to make beams for the houses which had ruined [the] kings of Judah.

en.L: And they gave [it] to the craftsmen and to the builders, to buy hewn stones and timber for the couplings, and to make beams for the buildings that the kings of Judah had let go to ruin.
en.B: They gave it to the craftsmen and the builders to buy dressed stone, and timber for the braces and for the beams of the buildings that the kings of Judah had allowed to fall into ruin.
en.R: They gave it to the craftsmen and the builders to buy cut stone and wood. The wood was for joining the walls and for the beams of the buildings that the kings of Judah had let fall apart.

es.L: Y [lo] dieron a los artesanos y a los constructores, para comprar piedras labradas y madera para los enlaces, y para hacer vigas para las casas que habían dejado arruinar los reyes de Judá.
es.B: Se lo dieron a los artesanos y a los constructores para comprar piedra labrada y madera para los tirantes y para las vigas de los edificios que los reyes de Judá habían dejado caer en ruinas.
es.R: Se lo dieron a los artesanos y a los constructores para comprar piedra cortada y madera. La madera era para unir las paredes y para las vigas de los edificios que los reyes de Judá habían dejado caer.

fr.L: Et ils le donnèrent aux artisans et aux bâtisseurs, pour acheter des pierres de taille et du bois pour les assemblages, et pour faire la charpente des bâtiments que les rois de Juda avaient laissés tomber en ruine.
fr.B: Ils le donnèrent aux artisans et aux bâtisseurs pour acheter des pierres taillées, et du bois pour les assemblages et pour la charpente des bâtiments que les rois de Juda avaient laissés tomber en ruine.
fr.R: Ils l’ont donné aux artisans et aux bâtisseurs pour acheter des pierres taillées et du bois. Le bois servait à relier les murs et à faire les poutres des bâtiments que les rois de Juda avaient laissés tomber en ruine.

sw.L: Wakaitoa kwa mafundi na kwa wajenzi, ili kununua mawe ya kuchonga na miti kwa ajili ya viungo, na kutengeneza boriti kwa ajili ya nyumba ambazo wafalme wa Yuda walikuwa wameziacha ziharibike.
sw.B: Waliwapa mafundi na wajenzi ili wanunue mawe yaliyochongwa, na mbao kwa ajili ya viunganishi na kwa ajili ya boriti za majengo ambayo wafalme wa Yuda walikuwa wameyaacha yaharibike.
sw.R: Waliwapa mafundi na wajenzi fedha hiyo ili wanunue mawe yaliyochongwa na mbao. Mbao hizo zilikuwa za kuunganisha kuta na za boriti za majengo ambayo wafalme wa Yuda walikuwa wameyaacha yabomoke.

vi.L: Họ giao [bạc] cho thợ thủ công và thợ xây để mua đá đẽo và gỗ làm khung nối, và để làm xà cho các tòa nhà mà các vua Giu-đa đã để hư nát.
vi.B: Họ giao bạc cho thợ thủ công và thợ xây để mua đá đã đẽo và gỗ làm khung nối và làm xà cho các tòa nhà mà các vua Giu-đa đã để cho đổ nát.
vi.R: Họ giao bạc cho thợ thủ công và thợ xây để mua đá đã đẽo và gỗ. Gỗ dùng để nối các bức tường và làm xà cho những tòa nhà mà các vua Giu-đa đã để cho hư hỏng.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그것을 기술자들과 건축하는 자들에게 주어, 다듬은 돌과 이음목으로 쓸 목재를 사게 하고, 유다 왕들이 허물어지게 한 건물들에 들보를 얹게 했다.
ko.B: 그들은 그 돈을 기술자들과 건축자들에게 주어, 다듬은 돌과 버팀목으로 쓸 목재를 사게 하고, 유다 왕들이 무너지게 내버려 둔 건물들의 들보를 놓게 했다.
ko.R: 그들은 그 돈을 기술자들과 건축자들에게 주어 깎은 돌과 나무를 사게 했다. 그 나무는 벽을 서로 잇고, 유다 왕들이 허물어지게 내버려 둔 건물들의 들보를 놓는 데 쓰였다.

pt.L: E [o] deram aos artífices e aos construtores, para comprar pedras lavradas e madeira para as junções, e para fazer vigas para as construções que os reis de Judá tinham deixado arruinar.
pt.B: Eles o deram aos artífices e aos construtores para comprar pedras lavradas e madeira para os travamentos e para as vigas das construções que os reis de Judá tinham deixado cair em ruínas.
pt.R: Eles o deram aos artesãos e aos construtores para comprar pedras cortadas e madeira. A madeira era para unir as paredes e para as vigas das construções que os reis de Judá tinham deixado desmoronar.

am.L: ለአናጢዎችና ለግንበኞችም የተጠረበ ድንጋይና ለማያያዣዎች እንጨት ይገዙበት ዘንድ፣ የይሁዳ ነገሥታት ያበላሿቸውንም ቤቶች ወራጅ ያደርጉላቸው ዘንድ ሰጡ።
am.B: የተጠረበ ድንጋይ እንዲገዙበት፣ የይሁዳ ነገሥታት እንዲፈራርሱ ለተዉአቸው ቤቶች ማያያዣና ወራጅ እንጨት እንዲገዙበት ለአናጢዎችና ለግንበኞች ሰጡ።
am.R: የተጠረበ ድንጋይና እንጨት እንዲገዙበት ለአናጢዎችና ለግንበኞች ሰጡ። እንጨቱ ግንቦቹን ለማያያዝና የይሁዳ ነገሥታት እንዲፈራርሱ ለተዉአቸው ቤቶች ወራጅ ለማድረግ የሚያገለግል ነበር።

hi.L: और उन्होंने [उसे] कारीगरों और राजमिस्त्रियों को दिया, कि गढ़े हुए पत्थर और जोड़ों के लिए लकड़ी ख़रीदें, और उन इमारतों के लिए कड़ियाँ बनाएँ जिन्हें यहूदा के राजाओं ने उजड़ने दिया था।
hi.B: उन्होंने उसे कारीगरों और राजमिस्त्रियों को दिया कि वे गढ़े हुए पत्थर ख़रीदें, और जोड़ने के लिए और उन इमारतों की कड़ियों के लिए लकड़ी ख़रीदें जिन्हें यहूदा के राजाओं ने खंडहर होने दिया था।
hi.R: उन्होंने उसे कारीगरों और राजमिस्त्रियों को दिया कि वे कटे हुए पत्थर और लकड़ी ख़रीदें। लकड़ी दीवारों को जोड़ने के लिए, और उन इमारतों की कड़ियों के लिए थी जिन्हें यहूदा के राजाओं ने टूटने-फूटने दिया था।

ru.L: И отдали они [его] плотникам и строителям, чтобы покупать тёсаные камни и дерево для связей и делать балки для домов, которые разрушили цари Иуды.
ru.B: Они отдавали их плотникам и строителям, чтобы покупать тёсаный камень и брёвна для связей и для балок зданий, которые цари Иуды довели до разрушения.
ru.R: Они отдавали их плотникам и строителям, чтобы покупать тёсаный камень и дерево. Дерево было нужно для скрепления стен и для балок зданий, которые цари Иуды довели до развала.

ja.L: そして彼らは、職人たちと建築する者たちに[それを]渡し、切り石と、つなぎのための材木を買い、ユダの王たちが荒れるに任せた建物の梁を造らせた。
ja.B: 彼らはそれを職人や建築する者たちに渡し、切り石を買わせ、またユダの王たちが荒れるままにしていた建物のつなぎ材や梁のための材木を買わせた。
ja.R: 彼らは、そのお金を職人や建築をする人たちに渡し、切った石や木材を買わせました。その木材は、ユダの王たちが壊れるままにしていた建物の、壁をつなぐ材木や梁にするためのものでした。

uk.L: І дали [його] ремісникам і будівничим, щоб купити тесаного каміння і дерева для скріплень, і щоб зробити балки для будівель, які царі Юди довели до руїни.
uk.B: Вони дали його ремісникам і будівничим, щоб купити тесаного каміння і дерева для скріплень і для балок будівель, які царі Юди довели до руїни.
uk.R: Вони дали його ремісникам і будівничим, щоб купити тесаного каміння і дерева. Дерево було для скріплення стін і для балок будівель, які царі Юди довели до занепаду.

decisions.choice: craftsmen, builders, hewn stone and timber: as in 2 Kings 22:6
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 22:6 names the same workmen and materials, with the masons as well. Chronicles adds what the timber was for, and that the buildings had been ruined by the kings of Judah.

decisions.choice: couplings and beams: timber to bind and roof the buildings
decisions.reason: The first word comes from a verb meaning to join; it names timbers that tied the walls together (1 Chronicles 22:3 uses it of iron clamps). The verb that follows means to lay beams, to put roofs and floors on the buildings.

decisions.choice: the buildings the kings of Judah had ruined: let fall into ruin
decisions.reason: The verb means to ruin or destroy. The kings before Josiah, Manasseh and Amon above all, had neglected the temple and its buildings and used them for other gods (33:4-7, 22). "The buildings" are the rooms and halls of the temple courts.

decisions.choice: hewn stones / dressed stone / cut stone; couplings / braces / for joining the walls
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 22:6 for the stone. Literal says "let go to ruin" and Balanced "allowed to fall into ruin" for what the kings did, to show that the ruin came through neglect as well as harm (m3).

decisions.choice: artífices (L, B), artesãos (R); pedras lavradas (L, B), pedras cortadas (R); junções (L), travamentos (B), unir as paredes (R)
decisions.reason: The workmen and the stone keep the Portuguese of 2 Kings 22:6 at each level (m1). The timber for "couplings" (m2) ties the walls together: "junções" at Literal, "travamentos", the builder's word for bracing, at Balanced, and Readable says what it was for, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "አናጢዎች", "ግንበኞች", "የተጠረበ ድንጋይ" as in 2 Kings 22:6; couplings "ማያያዣዎች" and beams "ወራጅ" for Chronicles' own words.
decisions.reason: The words Chronicles shares with Kings keep the Kings Amharic; "ወራጅ" is the common word for roof beams.

source.text: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים֩ עֹשִׂ֨ים בֶּאֱמוּנָ֜ה בַּמְּלָאכָ֗ה וַעֲלֵיהֶ֣ם׀מֻ֠פְקָדִים יַ֣חַת וְעֹבַדְיָ֤הוּ הַלְוִיִּם֙ מִן־בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י וּזְכַרְיָ֧ה וּמְשֻׁלָּ֛ם מִן־בְּנֵ֥י הַקְּהָתִ֖ים לְנַצֵּ֑חַ וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם כָּל־מֵבִ֖ין בִּכְלֵי־שִֽׁיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And the men [were] working in faithfulness in the work; and over them [were] appointed Jahath and Obadiah the Levites from [the] sons of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam from [the] sons of the Kohathites, to oversee; and the Levites, every one skilled in instruments of song,

en.L: And the men were doing the work in faithfulness; and over them were appointed Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites of the sons of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to oversee; and the Levites, everyone skilled with instruments of song,
en.B: The men did the work honestly. Over them were appointed Jahath and Obadiah, Levites of the descendants of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the descendants of Kohath, to direct the work. And the Levites, all who were skilled with musical instruments,
en.R: The men worked honestly. The leaders over them were Jahath and Obadiah, Levites from the family of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam from the family of Kohath. These men directed the work. Other Levites, all of them skilled musicians,

es.L: Y los hombres hacían la obra con fidelidad; y sobre ellos estaban puestos Jahat y Abdías, levitas de los hijos de Merari, y Zacarías y Mesulam, de los hijos de los coatitas, para dirigir; y los levitas, todos los hábiles en instrumentos de música,
es.B: Los hombres hacían la obra con honradez. Al frente de ellos estaban Jahat y Abdías, levitas de los descendientes de Merari, y Zacarías y Mesulam, de los descendientes de Coat, para dirigir la obra. Y los levitas, todos los que eran hábiles con los instrumentos de música,
es.R: Los hombres trabajaban con honradez. Los jefes que estaban sobre ellos eran Jahat y Abdías, levitas de la familia de Merari, y Zacarías y Mesulam, de la familia de Coat. Ellos dirigían la obra. Otros levitas, todos buenos músicos,

fr.L: Et les hommes faisaient l’ouvrage avec fidélité ; et au-dessus d’eux étaient préposés Yahath et Abdias, les Lévites, d’entre les fils de Merari, et Zacharie et Meshoullam, d’entre les fils des Kehathites, pour diriger ; et les Lévites, tous ceux qui savaient jouer des instruments de musique,
fr.B: Les hommes faisaient le travail honnêtement. Au-dessus d’eux, pour diriger les travaux, on avait placé Yahath et Abdias, des Lévites descendants de Merari, et Zacharie et Meshoullam, des descendants de Kehath. Et les Lévites, tous ceux qui savaient jouer des instruments de musique,
fr.R: Les hommes travaillaient honnêtement. Leurs chefs étaient Yahath et Abdias, des Lévites de la famille de Merari, et Zacharie et Meshoullam, de la famille de Kehath. Ces hommes dirigeaient les travaux. D’autres Lévites, tous de bons musiciens,

sw.L: Na watu hao walifanya kazi kwa uaminifu; na juu yao waliwekwa Yahathi na Obadia, Walawi wa wana wa Merari, na Zekaria na Meshulamu, wa wana wa Wakohathi, ili kusimamia; na Walawi, kila aliyekuwa stadi wa vyombo vya kuimbia,
sw.B: Watu hao walifanya kazi kwa uaminifu. Juu yao waliwekwa Yahathi na Obadia, Walawi wa wazao wa Merari, na Zekaria na Meshulamu, wa wazao wa Kohathi, ili kuiongoza kazi. Na Walawi, wote waliokuwa stadi wa vyombo vya muziki,
sw.R: Watu hao walifanya kazi kwa uaminifu. Viongozi wao walikuwa Yahathi na Obadia, Walawi wa jamaa ya Merari, na Zekaria na Meshulamu wa jamaa ya Kohathi. Watu hao waliiongoza kazi. Walawi wengine, wote wakiwa wanamuziki stadi,

vi.L: Những người ấy làm công việc cách trung tín; những người được đặt trên họ để giám sát là Gia-hát và Áp-đia, người Lê-vi thuộc con cháu Mê-ra-ri, Xa-cha-ri và Mê-su-lam thuộc con cháu Kê-hát; và những người Lê-vi, mọi người giỏi về nhạc cụ,
vi.B: Những người ấy làm việc cách trung thực. Những người được đặt trên họ để điều khiển công việc là Gia-hát và Áp-đia, người Lê-vi thuộc dòng dõi Mê-ra-ri, cùng Xa-cha-ri và Mê-su-lam thuộc dòng dõi Kê-hát. Còn những người Lê-vi, tất cả những người giỏi về nhạc cụ,
vi.R: Những người thợ làm việc cách trung thực. Những người lãnh đạo họ là Gia-hát và Áp-đia, người Lê-vi thuộc gia tộc Mê-ra-ri, cùng Xa-cha-ri và Mê-su-lam thuộc gia tộc Kê-hát. Những người này điều khiển công việc. Những người Lê-vi khác, tất cả đều là nhạc công giỏi,

am.L: ሰዎቹም ሥራውን በታማኝነት ይሠሩ ነበር፤ በእነርሱም ላይ ይቆጣጠሩ ዘንድ ከሜራሪ ልጆች ሌዋውያኑ ያሐትና አብድዩ፣ ከቀዓታውያንም ልጆች ዘካርያስና ሜሶላም ተሾመው ነበር፤ ሌዋውያኑም፣ በዜማ ዕቃዎች የተካኑ ሁሉ፣
am.B: ሰዎቹ ሥራውን በታማኝነት ሠሩ። ሥራውን እንዲመሩ በእነርሱ ላይ የተሾሙት ከሜራሪ ዘሮች የሆኑት ሌዋውያኑ ያሐትና አብድዩ፣ ከቀዓት ዘሮችም ዘካርያስና ሜሶላም ነበሩ። በዜማ መሣሪያዎች የተካኑት ሌዋውያን ሁሉ ደግሞ
am.R: ሰዎቹ በታማኝነት ሠሩ። በእነርሱ ላይ መሪዎች የነበሩት ከሜራሪ ቤተሰብ የሆኑት ሌዋውያኑ ያሐትና አብድዩ፣ ከቀዓት ቤተሰብም ዘካርያስና ሜሶላም ነበሩ። እነዚህ ሰዎች ሥራውን ይመሩ ነበር። በሙዚቃ መሣሪያዎች የተካኑ ሌሎች ሌዋውያን ደግሞ

hi.L: और वे पुरुष सच्चाई से काम करते थे; और उन पर मरारी के पुत्रों में के लेवी यहत और ओबद्याह, और कहातियों के पुत्रों में के जकर्याह और मशुल्लाम देखरेख करने को ठहराए गए थे; और लेवी, हर एक जो गीत के बाजों में निपुण था,
hi.B: वे पुरुष ईमानदारी से काम करते थे। उन पर मरारी के वंशज लेवी यहत और ओबद्याह, और कहात के वंशज जकर्याह और मशुल्लाम काम चलाने को ठहराए गए थे। और लेवी, जितने बाजे बजाने में निपुण थे,
hi.R: वे पुरुष ईमानदारी से काम करते थे। उनके ऊपर अगुवे थे मरारी के कुल के लेवी यहत और ओबद्याह, और कहात के कुल के जकर्याह और मशुल्लाम। ये लोग काम चलाते थे। दूसरे लेवी, जो सब निपुण बजानेवाले थे,

ru.L: И люди исполняли работу с верностью; а над ними были поставлены Иахаф и Авдий, левиты из сыновей Мерари, и Захария и Мешуллам из сыновей каафитов, чтобы руководить; и левиты, всякий, кто умел [играть] на музыкальных инструментах,
ru.B: Люди выполняли работу честно. Над ними были поставлены Иахаф и Авдий, левиты из потомков Мерари, и Захария и Мешуллам из потомков Каафа, чтобы руководить работой. А левиты, все, кто умел играть на музыкальных инструментах,
ru.R: Люди работали честно. Начальниками над ними были Иахаф и Авдий, левиты из рода Мерари, и Захария и Мешуллам из рода Каафа. Эти люди руководили работой. Другие левиты, все искусные музыканты,

uk.L: А люди виконували роботу вірно; а над ними були поставлені Яхат і Овдій, левити з синів Мерарі, і Захарія та Мешуллам, з синів кегатівців, щоб наглядати; і левити, кожен, хто вмів грати на інструментах пісні,
uk.B: Люди виконували роботу чесно. Над ними були поставлені Яхат і Овдій, левити з нащадків Мерарі, і Захарія та Мешуллам з нащадків Кегата, щоб керувати роботою. А левити, усі, хто вмів грати на музичних інструментах,

decisions.choice: doing the work in faithfulness: as 2 Kings 22:7 says of the overseers
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 22:7 says that no account was asked of those who handled the money, "for they act in faithfulness". Chronicles says the same of the men at work, using the same noun: they could be trusted.

decisions.choice: Levites of Merari and of Kohath: two of the three Levite clans
decisions.reason: The Levites were divided into the clans of Gershon, Kohath and Merari, the sons of Levi (1 Chronicles 6:1; 23:6). Chronicles names Levites from each clan when the temple is cleansed (29:12) and here sets two clans over the work.

decisions.choice: to oversee: to direct the work
decisions.reason: The verb means to lead or direct, and is used of the Levites who directed the building of the temple (1 Chronicles 23:4; Ezra 3:8-9). It is from the same root as the word in many psalm titles for the leader of the music.

decisions.choice: the Levites skilled in music: the sentence goes on into verse 13
alternatives: and the Levites, all skilled in music, accompanied the work
decisions.reason: The words "and the Levites, everyone skilled with instruments of song" begin a new clause that verse 13 finishes: these Levites were over the porters and directed the workmen. Musicians were set over the labor, as the Levites had led worship with music when the temple was cleansed (29:25-30). The words may instead mean that these Levites played music while the work went on, but the Hebrew does not say so.

decisions.choice: did the work honestly (Balanced); worked honestly (Readable); to direct the work
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 22:7 for "in faithfulness" at Balanced and Readable ("they deal honestly", "they are honest"). "Sons of" a clan's founder is "descendants" at Balanced and "family" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "con fidelidad" (L); "con honradez" (B, R); "Jahat", "Abdías", "Mesulam"
decisions.reason: As Spanish 2 Kings 22:7 words the workers' faithfulness at each level; the names in their usual Spanish forms.

decisions.choice: "Yahath", "Abdias", "Meshoullam"
decisions.reason: "Abdias" is the French form the terms note sets for Obadiah; the other names in the forms of these books.

decisions.choice: the record ends with a comma and runs on into verse 13
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sentence goes on (m4); Vietnamese keeps it open as the English does, with the subject here and its verb in verse 13.

decisions.choice: The verse ends with the subject "레위인들 ... 모든 사람은", whose verbs come in verse 13
decisions.reason: The Hebrew clause runs on into verse 13 (m4); a Korean subject can stand at the end of one verse with its verb in the next, so each verse keeps its own words. "성실하게" (Literal), "정직하게" (Balanced, Readable) keep the wording of 2 Kings 22:7.

decisions.choice: com fidelidade (L); com honestidade (B, R)
decisions.reason: The noun of 2 Kings 22:7 (m1) keeps its Portuguese there, "fidelidade" at Literal and "honestidade" at Balanced and Readable. "Os filhos dos coatitas" (L), "descendentes de Coate" (B), "família de Coate" (R) as 20:19 and 1 Chronicles 15:5 have the clan (m2); "Jaate", "Obadias", "Zacarias" and "Mesulão" are the usual Brazilian forms.

decisions.choice: Names: Jahath "ያሐት" (new), Obadiah "አብድዩ" (as 1 Kings 18), Zechariah "ዘካርያስ", Meshullam "ሜሶላም" (as 2 Kings 22:3), Merari "ሜራሪ" and Kohath "ቀዓት", the Kohathites "ቀዓታውያን" (as Exodus 6).
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "the descendants of Kohath", as the English does; "በታማኝነት" (faithfully) keeps the word of 2 Kings 22:7.

decisions.choice: "सच्चाई से" (L); "ईमानदारी से" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 22:7 for "in faithfulness"; the sons of Merari and of the Kohathites are "पुत्र" at Literal and "वंशज", "कुल" at the other levels, as the English says descendants and family.

decisions.choice: 34:12 ends with the Levite musicians as the subject ("…はみな、" L, B; "…で、" R) and their task follows in 34:13, as the English runs on.
decisions.reason: Each verse keeps its own content; Japanese allows the subject to stand at the verse end with a comma.

decisions.choice: Jahath "ヤハト", Obadiah "オバドヤ", Zechariah "ゼカリヤ", Meshullam "メシュラム"; benei Merari / haqqehati "メラリの子ら" / "ケハト人の子ら" (L), "…の子孫" (B), "…の一族" (R), as 1 Chronicles.
decisions.reason: The Levite clan forms of 1 Chronicles 23-26.

source.text: וְעַ֣ל הַסַּבָּלִ֗ים וּֽמְנַצְּחִים֙ לְכֹל֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה מְלָאכָ֔ה לַעֲבוֹדָ֖ה וַעֲבוֹדָ֑ה וּמֵֽהַלְוִיִּ֔ם סוֹפְרִ֥ים וְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים וְשׁוֹעֲרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: and over the burden-bearers, and [were] overseeing all [the] doer[s] of work for service and service; and from the Levites [were] scribes and officials and gatekeepers.

en.L: and over the burden-bearers, and overseeing all who did the work, for service after service; and of the Levites [some were] scribes and officials and gatekeepers.
en.B: were over the porters and directed all the workmen in every kind of task. Some of the Levites were scribes, officials and gatekeepers.
en.R: were in charge of the men who carried the loads, and they directed all the workers in every kind of job. Some of the Levites were also scribes, officials and gatekeepers.

es.L: [estaban] sobre los cargadores, y dirigían a todos los que hacían la obra en cada servicio; y de los levitas [había] escribas, y oficiales, y porteros.
es.B: estaban al frente de los cargadores y dirigían a todos los obreros en toda clase de tareas. Algunos de los levitas eran escribas, oficiales y porteros.
es.R: estaban a cargo de los hombres que cargaban los materiales, y dirigían a todos los trabajadores en toda clase de trabajo. Algunos de los levitas también eran escribas, oficiales y porteros.

fr.L: [étaient] au-dessus des porteurs de fardeaux, et dirigeaient tous ceux qui faisaient l’ouvrage, pour chaque service ; et d’entre les Lévites [il y avait] des scribes, et des officiers, et des portiers.
fr.B: étaient au-dessus des porteurs et dirigeaient tous les ouvriers dans toutes sortes de tâches. Parmi les Lévites, il y avait aussi des scribes, des officiers et des portiers.
fr.R: étaient responsables des hommes qui portaient les charges, et ils dirigeaient tous les ouvriers dans toutes sortes de travaux. Certains Lévites étaient aussi scribes, officiers ou portiers.

sw.L: [walikuwa] juu ya wachukuzi wa mizigo, wakiwasimamia wote waliofanya kazi, kwa huduma baada ya huduma; na katika Walawi [walikuwako] waandishi na maafisa na mabawabu.
sw.B: walisimamia wachukuzi na kuwaongoza wafanyakazi wote katika kila aina ya kazi. Baadhi ya Walawi walikuwa waandishi, maafisa na mabawabu.
sw.R: walisimamia watu waliobeba mizigo, wakawaongoza wafanyakazi wote katika kila aina ya kazi. Baadhi ya Walawi walikuwa pia waandishi, maafisa na walinzi wa malango.

vi.L: cai quản những người khuân vác và giám sát mọi người làm công việc, hết việc này đến việc khác; trong những người Lê-vi [có người làm] ký lục, quan chức và người giữ cổng.
vi.B: thì cai quản những người khuân vác và điều khiển mọi người thợ trong mọi loại công việc. Một số người Lê-vi làm ký lục, quan chức và người giữ cổng.
vi.R: thì coi sóc những người khuân vác và điều khiển mọi người thợ trong mọi loại công việc. Một số người Lê-vi cũng làm ký lục, quan chức và người giữ cổng.

ko.L: 짐꾼들 위에 [있었고], 온갖 일을 하는 모든 일꾼을 감독했다. 그리고 레위인들 가운데 서기관들과 관리들과 문지기들이 [있었다].
ko.B: 짐꾼들을 맡았고, 온갖 일을 하는 모든 일꾼을 지휘했다. 레위인들 가운데 어떤 이들은 서기관과 관리와 문지기였다.
ko.R: 짐을 나르는 사람들을 맡았고, 온갖 일을 하는 모든 일꾼을 지휘했다. 레위인들 가운데 어떤 이들은 서기관과 관리와 문지기로도 일했다.

pt.L: e [estavam] sobre os carregadores, e dirigiam todos os que faziam o trabalho, serviço após serviço; e dos levitas [havia] escribas, e oficiais, e porteiros.
pt.B: estavam sobre os carregadores e dirigiam todos os trabalhadores em todo tipo de tarefa. Alguns dos levitas eram escribas, oficiais e porteiros.
pt.R: eram os responsáveis pelos homens que carregavam as cargas e dirigiam todos os trabalhadores em todo tipo de serviço. Alguns dos levitas também eram escribas, oficiais e porteiros.

am.L: በተሸካሚዎቹም ላይ [ነበሩ]፤ ለአገልግሎትና ለአገልግሎትም ሥራውን የሚሠሩትን ሁሉ ይቆጣጠሩ ነበር፤ ከሌዋውያኑም ጸሐፊዎችና ሹማምንት በር ጠባቂዎችም [ነበሩ]።
am.B: በተሸካሚዎቹ ላይ ኃላፊዎች ነበሩ፤ በየዓይነቱም ሥራ የሚሠሩትን ሠራተኞች ሁሉ ይመሩ ነበር። ከሌዋውያኑም አንዳንዶቹ ጸሐፊዎች፣ ሹማምንትና በር ጠባቂዎች ነበሩ።
am.R: ሸክም በሚሸከሙት ሰዎች ላይ ኃላፊዎች ነበሩ፤ በየዓይነቱም ሥራ የሚሠሩትን ሠራተኞች ሁሉ ይመሩ ነበር። ከሌዋውያንም አንዳንዶቹ ጸሐፊዎች፣ ሹማምንትና በር ጠባቂዎች ነበሩ።

hi.L: और बोझ ढोनेवालों पर [थे], और हर प्रकार की सेवा में काम करनेवालों की देखरेख करते थे; और लेवियों में से [कुछ] लेखक और अधिकारी और द्वारपाल [थे]।
hi.B: बोझ ढोनेवालों पर ठहराए गए थे, और हर प्रकार के काम में सब कारीगरों को चलाते थे। लेवियों में से कुछ लेखक, अधिकारी और द्वारपाल थे।
hi.R: बोझ उठानेवाले लोगों के अधिकारी थे, और हर तरह के काम में सब मज़दूरों को चलाते थे। कुछ लेवी लेखक, अधिकारी और द्वारपाल भी थे।

ru.L: и над носильщиками, и руководили всеми исполнителями работы для служения и служения; а из левитов [были] писцы, и надзиратели, и привратники.
ru.B: стояли над носильщиками и руководили всеми работниками на любой работе. Некоторые из левитов были писцами, надзирателями и привратниками.
ru.R: отвечали за людей, которые носили тяжести, и руководили всеми работниками на всякой работе. Некоторые левиты были также писцами, надзирателями и привратниками.

ja.L: 荷を担ぐ者たちの上に[立ち]、あらゆる務めのために工事をするすべての者を監督していた。そしてレビ人たちのうちには、書記と下役と門衛がいた。
ja.B: 荷を運ぶ者たちを管理し、あらゆる仕事をするすべての働き手を指揮した。レビ人たちの中には、書記、役人、門衛もいた。
ja.R: 荷物を運ぶ人たちを管理し、あらゆる仕事をする働き手たちを指揮しました。レビ人たちの中には、書記や役人や門番もいました。

uk.L: і над носіями тягарів, і наглядали за всіма, що виконували роботу, для служби за службою; а з левитів [були] писарі, і урядники, і сторожі брам.
uk.B: були над носіями і керували всіма робітниками в усякій праці. Деякі з левитів були писарями, урядниками і сторожами брам.
uk.R: відповідали за людей, що носили вантажі, і керували всіма робітниками в усякій праці. Деякі з левитів були також писарями, урядниками і сторожами брам.

decisions.choice: over the porters: the musicians of verse 12 in charge of the laborers
decisions.reason: The verse finishes the clause begun at the end of verse 12: the Levites skilled with instruments were over the burden-bearers and directed the workmen. The burden-bearers carried stone and timber (2:1, 17).

decisions.choice: for service and service: for every kind of task
decisions.reason: Repeating a noun with "and" means one after another, every one of its kind.

decisions.choice: scribes, officials and gatekeepers: other Levite duties
decisions.reason: David had appointed Levites as officials and judges, and as gatekeepers of the temple (1 Chronicles 23:4-5; 26:1-19). Scribes kept records and wrote documents (1 Chronicles 24:6). Chronicles shows the Levites serving in all these roles during the repairs.

decisions.choice: porters (Balanced); the men who carried the loads (Readable); officials
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the work the burden-bearers did. The word for "officials" is rendered as in Deuteronomy 16:18 at every level. Literal brackets "some were", which the Hebrew implies with "of the Levites".

decisions.choice: os carregadores (L, B), os homens que carregavam as cargas (R); escribas, oficiais e porteiros
decisions.reason: The burden-bearers are "carregadores", as 2:1 and 2:17 have them in Portuguese (m1). The Levites' offices (m3) are "escribas", for writers of records, apart from the king's "escrivão" Safã, "oficiais" as Deuteronomy 16:18, and "porteiros", the Chronicles term for the temple gatekeepers.

decisions.choice: Officials (shoterim) are "ሹማምንት", as in the Amharic Deuteronomy 1:15; gatekeepers "በር ጠባቂዎች".
decisions.reason: "አለቆች" is kept for commanders and chiefs.

decisions.choice: "अधिकारी" (shoterim)
decisions.reason: The shoterim are अधिकारी at every level, as in Deuteronomy 16:18.

decisions.choice: shoterim "下役" (L), "役人" (B, R); sho'arim "門衛" (L, B), "門番" (R), as 1 Chronicles 23 and 26.
decisions.reason: Settled Levite office terms.

source.text: וּבְהוֹצִיאָ֣ם אֶת־הַכֶּ֔סֶף הַמּוּבָ֖א בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה מָצָא֙ חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶת־סֵ֥פֶר תּֽוֹרַת־יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And when they brought out the money brought [into the] house of Yahweh, found Hilkiah the priest [the] book of [the] law of Yahweh by [the] hand of Moses.

en.L: And when they were bringing out the money that had been brought [into the] house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, Hilkiah the priest found the book of the law of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} by the hand of Moses.
en.B: As they were taking out the money brought into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the priest Hilkiah found the book of the law of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, given through Moses.
en.R: While they were bringing out the money that had been brought to the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, Hilkiah the priest found the book of {{divine_name:the LORD's|Yahweh's}} teaching that was given through Moses.

es.L: Y cuando sacaban el dinero que había sido traído [a la] casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el sacerdote Hilcías halló el libro de la ley {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [dada] por mano de Moisés.
es.B: Mientras sacaban el dinero que se había traído a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el sacerdote Hilcías encontró el libro de la ley {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, dada por medio de Moisés.
es.R: Mientras sacaban el dinero que se había traído al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el sacerdote Hilcías encontró el libro de la enseñanza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que fue dada por medio de Moisés.

fr.L: Et comme ils sortaient l’argent qu’on avait apporté [dans la] maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le prêtre Hilqiya trouva le livre de la loi {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [donnée] par la main de Moïse.
fr.B: Pendant qu’on sortait l’argent apporté dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le prêtre Hilqiya trouva le livre de la loi {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, donnée par Moïse.
fr.R: Pendant qu’on sortait l’argent que les gens avaient apporté au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le prêtre Hilqiya a trouvé le livre de l’enseignement {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, donné par Moïse.

sw.L: Nao walipokuwa wakiitoa fedha iliyoletwa [katika] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Hilkia kuhani akakiona kitabu cha Sheria ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa mkono wa Musa.
sw.B: Walipokuwa wakiitoa fedha iliyoletwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kuhani Hilkia alikiona kitabu cha Sheria ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, iliyotolewa kupitia Musa.
sw.R: Walipokuwa wakiitoa fedha iliyoletwa katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Hilkia kuhani alikiona kitabu cha mafundisho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yaliyotolewa kupitia Musa.

vi.L: Khi họ đem ra số bạc đã được đem vào nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thầy tế lễ Hinh-kia tìm thấy sách luật pháp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [ban] qua tay Môi-se.
vi.B: Đang khi họ lấy số bạc đã được đem vào nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ra, thầy tế lễ Hinh-kia tìm thấy sách luật pháp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban qua Môi-se.
vi.R: Đang khi họ lấy số bạc dân chúng đã đem đến đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ra, thầy tế lễ Hinh-kia tìm thấy sách chứa lời dạy của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban qua Môi-se.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어온 돈을 꺼낼 때에, 제사장 힐기야가 모세의 손으로 [준] {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 율법책을 찾았다.
ko.B: 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어온 돈을 꺼낼 때에, 제사장 힐기야가 모세를 통해 주신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 율법책을 찾아냈다.
ko.R: 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 들어온 돈을 꺼내고 있을 때에, 제사장 힐기야가 책 한 권을 찾았다. 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세를 통해 주신 가르침을 적은 책이었다.

pt.L: E, quando tiravam o dinheiro que tinha sido trazido [à] casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, Hilquias, o sacerdote, achou o Livro da Lei {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} pela mão de Moisés.
pt.B: Enquanto tiravam o dinheiro trazido à casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o sacerdote Hilquias encontrou o Livro da Lei {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, dada por meio de Moisés.
pt.R: Enquanto tiravam o dinheiro que tinha sido trazido ao templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o sacerdote Hilquias encontrou o livro do ensino {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que tinha sido dado por meio de Moisés.

am.L: ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቤት የገባውንም ገንዘብ ሲያወጡ ካህኑ ኬልቅያስ በሙሴ እጅ [የተሰጠውን] {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ሕግ መጽሐፍ አገኘ።
am.B: ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ የገባውን ገንዘብ ሲያወጡ ካህኑ ኬልቅያስ በሙሴ በኩል የተሰጠውን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ሕግ መጽሐፍ አገኘ።
am.R: ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ የገባውን ገንዘብ ሲያወጡ ካህኑ ኬልቅያስ በሙሴ በኩል የተሰጠውን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትምህርት የያዘውን መጽሐፍ አገኘ።

hi.L: और जब वे उस रुपये को निकाल रहे थे जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में लाया गया था, तब हिल्किय्याह याजक को मूसा के हाथ से [दी हुई] {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की व्यवस्था की पुस्तक मिली।
hi.B: जब वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में लाया गया रुपया निकाल रहे थे, तब हिल्किय्याह याजक को {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की व्यवस्था की वह पुस्तक मिली जो मूसा के द्वारा दी गई थी।
hi.R: जब वे वह रुपया बाहर निकाल रहे थे जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में लाया गया था, तब हिल्किय्याह याजक को {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शिक्षा की वह पुस्तक मिली जो मूसा के द्वारा दी गई थी।

ru.L: И когда выносили серебро, принесённое [в] дом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашёл Хелкия, священник, книгу закона {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, [данного] рукой Моисея.
ru.B: Когда выносили деньги, принесённые в дом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, священник Хелкия нашёл книгу закона {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, данного через Моисея.
ru.R: Когда выносили деньги, принесённые в храм {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, священник Хелкия нашёл книгу учения {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, которое было дано через Моисея.

ja.L: そして彼らが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家に持ち込まれた銀を運び出していたとき、祭司ヒルキヤは、モーセの手による{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の律法の書を見つけた。
ja.B: 人々が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家に納められた銀を運び出しているとき、祭司ヒルキヤは、モーセを通して与えられた{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の律法の書を見つけた。
ja.R: 人々が、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿に納められていたお金を運び出していたとき、祭司ヒルキヤは、モーセを通して与えられた{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の教えの書を見つけました。

uk.L: А коли виносили срібло, принесене [до] дому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}}, знайшов Хілкія, священник, книгу закону {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}} рукою Мойсея.
uk.B: Коли виносили срібло, принесене до дому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}}, священник Хілкія знайшов книгу закону {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}}, даного через Мойсея.
uk.R: Коли вони виносили срібло, принесене до храму {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}}, священник Хілкія знайшов книгу навчання {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}}, даного через Мойсея.

decisions.choice: the book of the law of Yahweh: the book of Yahweh's instruction
decisions.reason: The word for "law" (torah) means instruction or teaching, the whole of what Yahweh taught through Moses, not only rules (Deuteronomy 1:5; 31:9). 2 Kings 22:8 calls it "the book of the law"; Chronicles names it more fully as Yahweh's and given through Moses. On which book this was, see the note at 2 Kings 22:8: what it leads Josiah to do matches Deuteronomy closely.

decisions.choice: by the hand of Moses: given through Moses
decisions.reason: "By the hand of" a person means through him, as an agent. The law came from Yahweh and was given through Moses (35:6; Leviticus 8:36).

decisions.choice: found while the money was being brought out
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 22:8 does not say when the book was found; Chronicles ties the finding to the bringing out of the money for the repairs (verse 9). Kings gives Hilkiah's own words first; Chronicles tells the finding, then gives his words in verse 15.

decisions.choice: the book of the LORD's teaching (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says "teaching" for torah, as at 2 Kings 22:8, because "law" alone makes most readers think only of rules (m1). Literal and Balanced keep "the book of the law".

decisions.choice: "el libro de la ley" (L, B); "el libro de la enseñanza del SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: As the 2 Kings note settles it: "ley" at Literal and Balanced, "enseñanza" at Readable, as in Spanish 2 Kings 22:8.

decisions.choice: "le livre de la loi du SEIGNEUR" (Literal, Balanced); "le livre de l'enseignement du SEIGNEUR" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As French 2 Kings 22:8: Readable says what the book was.

decisions.choice: kitabu cha mafundisho ya BWANA (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "mafundisho" (teaching) for torah, as the Swahili of 2 Kings 22:8 does; Literal and Balanced keep "kitabu cha Sheria".

decisions.choice: "sách luật pháp" (L, B); "sách chứa lời dạy" (R)
decisions.reason: The 2 Kings 22 drafts' wording for the same book; Readable says "teaching" as the English does.

decisions.choice: "율법책" (Literal, Balanced), "가르침을 적은 책" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for the book of the Law, with the Readable wording of the 2 Kings 22:8 draft.

decisions.choice: o Livro da Lei do SENHOR (L, B); o livro do ensino do SENHOR (R); pela mão de Moisés (L), dada por meio de Moisés (B)
decisions.reason: The book keeps the name 2 Kings 22:8 and 17:9 give it in Portuguese (m1): "o Livro da Lei" with capitals at Literal and Balanced, "o livro do ensino" at Readable. Balanced's "dada" agrees with "a Lei", given through Moses (m2), as the English says "given through Moses".

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ሕግ መጽሐፍ" (Literal, Balanced) and "{{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ትምህርት የያዘው መጽሐፍ" (Readable), the wording of 2 Kings 22:8 for the book of the law.
decisions.reason: The book is named as in Kings; "ኦሪት" would name the five books of Moses, which the text does not say.

decisions.choice: "प्रभु की शिक्षा की पुस्तक" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "शिक्षा" (teaching) for torah, as at 2 Kings 22:8; Literal and Balanced keep "व्यवस्था".

decisions.choice: "книга учения ГОСПОДА" (R); "книга закона" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The forms of 2 Kings 22:8-11 in this translation, where Readable also says "teaching" for torah.

decisions.choice: sefer torat YHWH "主の律法の書" (L, B), "主の教えの書" (R); sefer hattorah "律法の書" (L, B), "主の教えの書" (R, with the divine name span where the English has it), as 2 Kings 22:8-11 and 2 Chronicles 17:9.
decisions.reason: The settled forms for the book Josiah found.

source.text: וַיַּ֣עַן חִלְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־שָׁפָ֣ן הַסּוֹפֵ֔ר סֵ֧פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֛ה מָצָ֖אתִי בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֧ן חִלְקִיָּ֛הוּ אֶת־הַסֵּ֖פֶר אֶל־שָׁפָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And answered Hilkiah and said to Shaphan the scribe, [the] book of the law I have found in [the] house of Yahweh; and gave Hilkiah the book to Shaphan.

en.L: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, "The book of the law I have found in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}." And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan.
en.B: Hilkiah spoke up and said to Shaphan the secretary, "In the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I have found the book of the law." Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan.
en.R: Hilkiah told Shaphan the secretary, "I have found the book of {{divine_name:the LORD's|Yahweh's}} teaching in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}." He gave the book to Shaphan.

es.L: E Hilcías respondió y dijo al escriba Safán: «El libro de la ley he hallado en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}». E Hilcías dio el libro a Safán.
es.B: Hilcías tomó la palabra y le dijo al secretario Safán: «En la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} he encontrado el libro de la ley». Hilcías le dio el libro a Safán.
es.R: Hilcías le dijo al secretario Safán: «He encontrado en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} el libro de la enseñanza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}». Le dio el libro a Safán.

fr.L: Et Hilqiya prit la parole et dit à Shaphân le scribe : « J’ai trouvé le livre de la Loi dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. » Et Hilqiya donna le livre à Shaphân.
fr.B: Hilqiya prit la parole et dit à Shaphân, le secrétaire : « J’ai trouvé le livre de la Loi dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. » Hilqiya donna le livre à Shaphân.
fr.R: Hilqiya a dit à Shaphân, le secrétaire : « J’ai trouvé le livre de l’enseignement {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. » Il a donné le livre à Shaphân.

sw.L: Hilkia akajibu, akamwambia Shafani mwandishi, "Kitabu cha Sheria nimekiona katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}." Naye Hilkia akampa Shafani kitabu hicho.
sw.B: Hilkia akamwambia Shafani katibu, "Katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nimekiona kitabu cha Sheria." Hilkia akampa Shafani kitabu hicho.
sw.R: Hilkia akamwambia Shafani katibu, "Nimekiona kitabu cha mafundisho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}." Akampa Shafani kitabu hicho.

vi.L: Hinh-kia lên tiếng nói với thư ký Sa-phan: "Sách luật pháp, tôi đã tìm thấy trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}." Hinh-kia đưa sách cho Sa-phan.
vi.B: Hinh-kia lên tiếng nói với thư ký Sa-phan: "Tôi đã tìm thấy sách luật pháp trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}." Hinh-kia đưa sách cho Sa-phan.
vi.R: Hinh-kia nói với thư ký Sa-phan: "Tôi đã tìm thấy sách chứa lời dạy của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}." Ông đưa sách cho Sa-phan.

ko.L: 그리고 힐기야가 서기관 사반에게 대답하여 말했다. "율법책을 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 찾았소." 그리고 힐기야가 그 책을 사반에게 주었다.
ko.B: 힐기야가 서기관 사반에게 말했다. "내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 율법책을 찾았소." 힐기야는 그 책을 사반에게 주었다.
ko.R: 힐기야가 서기관 사반에게 말했다. "내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침을 적은 책을 찾았소." 그는 그 책을 사반에게 주었다.

pt.L: E Hilquias respondeu e disse a Safã, o escrivão: "O Livro da Lei eu achei na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}." E Hilquias deu o livro a Safã.
pt.B: Hilquias tomou a palavra e disse ao secretário Safã: "Na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} encontrei o Livro da Lei." Hilquias entregou o livro a Safã.
pt.R: Hilquias disse a Safã, o secretário: "Encontrei no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} o livro do ensino {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}." Ele entregou o livro a Safã.

am.L: ኬልቅያስም መልሶ ጸሐፊውን ሳፋንን፦ «የሕግን መጽሐፍ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤት አገኘሁ» አለው። ኬልቅያስም መጽሐፉን ለሳፋን ሰጠው።
am.B: ኬልቅያስ ጸሐፊውን ሳፋንን፦ «{{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ የሕግን መጽሐፍ አገኘሁ» አለው። ኬልቅያስም መጽሐፉን ለሳፋን ሰጠው።
am.R: ኬልቅያስ ጸሐፊውን ሳፋንን፦ «{{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትምህርት የያዘውን መጽሐፍ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ውስጥ አገኘሁ» አለው። ከዚያም መጽሐፉን ለሳፋን ሰጠው።

hi.L: और हिल्किय्याह ने शापान लेखक से उत्तर देकर कहा, "मुझे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में व्यवस्था की पुस्तक मिली है।" और हिल्किय्याह ने वह पुस्तक शापान को दी।
hi.B: हिल्किय्याह ने शापान सचिव से कहा, "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में मुझे व्यवस्था की पुस्तक मिली है।" हिल्किय्याह ने वह पुस्तक शापान को दी।
hi.R: हिल्किय्याह ने शापान सचिव से कहा, "मुझे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शिक्षा की पुस्तक मिली है।" उसने वह पुस्तक शापान को दी।

ru.L: И ответил Хелкия, и сказал Шафану, писцу: «Книгу закона я нашёл в доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.» И дал Хелкия книгу Шафану.
ru.B: Хелкия обратился к писцу Шафану и сказал: «В доме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} я нашёл книгу закона.» Хелкия дал книгу Шафану.
ru.R: Хелкия сказал писцу Шафану: «Я нашёл в храме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} книгу учения {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.» Он дал книгу Шафану.

ja.L: そしてヒルキヤは答えて書記シャファンに言った。「わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家で律法の書を見つけた。」そしてヒルキヤはその書をシャファンに渡した。
ja.B: ヒルキヤは書記シャファンに告げた。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家で律法の書を見つけた。」ヒルキヤはその書をシャファンに渡した。
ja.R: ヒルキヤは、書記のシャファンに言いました。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿で、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の教えの書を見つけた。」ヒルキヤは、その書をシャファンに渡しました。

uk.L: І відповів Хілкія і сказав Шафанові, писареві: «Книгу закону я знайшов у домі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОМУ|Ягве}}.» І дав Хілкія книгу Шафанові.
uk.B: Хілкія заговорив і сказав писареві Шафанові: «У домі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОМУ|Ягве}} я знайшов книгу закону.» Хілкія дав книгу Шафанові.
uk.R: Хілкія сказав писареві Шафанові: «Я знайшов у храмі {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОМУ|Ягве}} книгу навчання {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}}.» Він дав книгу Шафанові.

decisions.choice: Hilkiah's words: as in 2 Kings 22:8
decisions.reason: Hilkiah's words are the same as in 2 Kings 22:8. Chronicles says that he "answered and said", calls him only "Hilkiah" here, and does not say that Shaphan read the book before taking it to the king, as Kings does.

decisions.choice: answered and said: spoke up
decisions.reason: "Answered" often begins a speech that responds to a situation rather than to a question (1 Chronicles 12:18). Hilkiah speaks because of what he has found.

decisions.choice: Shaphan the scribe: the royal secretary
decisions.reason: The scribe was one of the king's chief officials, who kept records and handled royal business (2 Kings 22:3).

decisions.choice: the scribe / the secretary; the book of the law / the book of the LORD's teaching
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 22:8 where the Hebrew is the same. Balanced says "spoke up" for "answered" (m2), and Readable gives only "told".

decisions.choice: mwandishi (L); katibu (B, R)
decisions.reason: The royal scribe is worded as in 2 Kings 22:8-12 at Balanced and Readable; Literal says "mwandishi", as the English Literal says "scribe".

decisions.choice: Hilkiah speaks to Shaphan in 하오체 ("찾았소")
decisions.reason: As in the 2 Kings 22:8 draft, whose words these are: two senior officials of the court speak to each other in 하오체.

decisions.choice: Hilquias's words as 2 Kings 22:8; respondeu e disse (L), tomou a palavra (B); o escrivão (L), o secretário (B, R)
decisions.reason: Hilquias's words keep the Portuguese of 2 Kings 22:8 at each level (m1), with Safã "o escrivão" at Literal and "o secretário" at Balanced and Readable, as 2 Kings 22:3 sets the office. Balanced says "tomou a palavra" for "answered", since he speaks up rather than replies (m2).

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 2 Kings 22:8, with "መልሶ" (answered, Literal), without "the high priest" and without "and he read it".
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "answered and said", calls Hilkiah by name only, and leaves the reading to verse 18.

decisions.choice: "शापान लेखक" (L); "शापान सचिव" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 22:8 where the Hebrew is the same.

source.text: וַיָּבֵ֨א שָׁפָ֤ן אֶת־הַסֵּ֨פֶר֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיָּ֨שֶׁב ע֧וֹד אֶת־הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ דָּבָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־נִתַּ֥ן בְּיַד־עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים׃

records.literal_gloss: And brought Shaphan the book to the king, and he brought back further [to] the king word, saying, all that was given in [the] hand of your servants they [are] doing.

en.L: And Shaphan brought the book to the king, and further brought back word to the king, saying, "All that was given into the hand of your servants they are doing.
en.B: Shaphan took the book to the king and also reported to him: "Your officials are doing everything that was entrusted to them.
en.R: Shaphan took the book to the king and also gave him a report. "Your officials are doing everything you told them to do.

es.L: Y Safán llevó el libro al rey, y además le llevó respuesta al rey, diciendo: «Todo lo que fue encomendado en mano de tus siervos, lo están haciendo.
es.B: Safán le llevó el libro al rey y además le informó: «Tus funcionarios están haciendo todo lo que se les encomendó.
es.R: Safán le llevó el libro al rey y también le dio un informe: «Tus funcionarios están haciendo todo lo que les mandaste.

fr.L: Et Shaphân apporta le livre au roi, et il rapporta encore une parole au roi, en disant : « Tout ce qui a été remis entre les mains de tes serviteurs, ils le font.
fr.B: Shaphân apporta le livre au roi et lui rendit aussi compte : « Tes officiers font tout ce qu’on leur a confié.
fr.R: Shaphân a apporté le livre au roi, et il lui a aussi fait son rapport : « Tes officiers font tout ce que tu leur as demandé.

sw.L: Shafani akamletea mfalme kitabu, tena akamrudishia mfalme habari, akisema, "Yote yaliyotiwa katika mkono wa watumishi wako wanayafanya.
sw.B: Shafani alimpelekea mfalme kitabu hicho, akampa pia taarifa: "Maafisa wako wanafanya kila kitu walichokabidhiwa.
sw.R: Shafani alimpelekea mfalme kitabu hicho, akampa pia taarifa: "Maafisa wako wanafanya kila kitu ulichowaagiza.

vi.L: Sa-phan đem sách đến cho vua, và còn tâu trình lại với vua rằng: "Mọi việc đã giao vào tay các đầy tớ của vua, họ đang làm.
vi.B: Sa-phan đem sách đến cho vua và cũng tâu với vua: "Các triều thần của bệ hạ đang làm mọi việc đã giao cho họ.
vi.R: Sa-phan đem sách đến cho vua và cũng báo cáo với vua: "Các quan chức của đức vua đang làm mọi việc đức vua đã giao.

ko.L: 그리고 사반이 그 책을 왕에게 가져가고, 또 왕에게 보고하여 말했다. "임금님의 종들의 손에 맡겨진 모든 것을 그들이 하고 있습니다.
ko.B: 사반은 그 책을 왕에게 가져가서 보고했다. "임금님의 신하들은 맡겨진 일을 모두 하고 있습니다.
ko.R: 사반은 그 책을 왕에게 가져가서 일이 어떻게 되었는지 보고했다. "임금님의 신하들은 임금님께서 시키신 일을 모두 하고 있습니다.

pt.L: E Safã levou o livro ao rei, e trouxe de volta palavra ao rei, dizendo: "Tudo o que foi dado na mão dos seus servos eles estão fazendo.
pt.B: Safã levou o livro ao rei e também lhe prestou contas: "Os seus oficiais estão fazendo tudo o que lhes foi confiado.
pt.R: Safã levou o livro ao rei e também lhe deu um relatório: "Os seus oficiais estão fazendo tudo o que o senhor mandou.

am.L: ሳፋንም መጽሐፉን ወደ ንጉሡ አመጣ፤ ለንጉሡም ደግሞ መልስ አመጣ፤ እንዲህም አለ፦ «ባሪያዎችዎ በእጃቸው የተሰጠውን ሁሉ እያደረጉ ነው።
am.B: ሳፋን መጽሐፉን ወደ ንጉሡ ወሰደ፤ ደግሞም እንዲህ ሲል ነገረው፦ «ሹማምንትዎ በአደራ የተሰጣቸውን ሁሉ እየፈጸሙ ነው።
am.R: ሳፋን መጽሐፉን ወደ ንጉሡ ወሰደ፤ ደግሞም ስለ ሥራው ነገረው፦ «ሹማምንትዎ ያዘዟቸውን ሁሉ እያደረጉ ነው።

hi.L: और शापान पुस्तक को राजा के पास ले गया, और राजा को फिर यह समाचार दिया, "जो कुछ आपके दासों के हाथ में सौंपा गया था, वे उसे कर रहे हैं।
hi.B: शापान पुस्तक को राजा के पास ले गया और उसे यह समाचार भी दिया: "जो कुछ आपके अधिकारियों को सौंपा गया था, वे सब कर रहे हैं।
hi.R: शापान पुस्तक को राजा के पास ले गया और उसे समाचार भी दिया। "आपके अधिकारी वह सब कर रहे हैं जो आपने उन्हें करने को कहा था।

ru.L: И принёс Шафан книгу царю, и ещё дал царю ответ, говоря: «Всё, что дано в руку твоих рабов, они делают.

decisions.choice: brought back word to the king: reported to him
decisions.reason: To bring back a word is to give a report on a task one was sent to do, as in 2 Kings 22:9. "Further" adds the report to the bringing of the book.

decisions.choice: your servants: the king's officials
decisions.reason: Shaphan speaks of the men who carried out the king's order as the king's servants, his officials, as in 2 Kings 22:9.

decisions.choice: Shaphan brings the book with his report
decisions.reason: In 2 Kings 22:9 Shaphan first reports on the money and only then speaks of the book (2 Kings 22:10). Here he brings the book to the king at the outset, and his report on the work runs into verse 17.

decisions.choice: your officials (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The king's servants are "officials" at Balanced and Readable, as throughout these books; Literal keeps "servants". Shaphan's report opens with a double quote mark here and closes at the end of verse 17.

decisions.choice: "các đầy tớ của vua" (L); "các triều thần của bệ hạ" (B); "các quan chức của đức vua" (R)
decisions.reason: The address to the king and the king's servants as the terms note and 2 Kings 22:9.

decisions.choice: trouxe de volta palavra (L), prestou contas (B); os seus servos (L), os seus oficiais (B, R); o senhor (R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 22:9 in Portuguese (m1, m2): Safã speaks to the king with "seus" and "o senhor", the address of a subject to a king. His report opens here and closes at the end of verse 17, as in the English.

decisions.choice: Shaphan speaks to the king with the respectful -ዎ, as in 2 Kings 22:9: "ባሪያዎችዎ" (Literal), "ሹማምንትዎ" (Balanced, Readable).
decisions.reason: Officials address the king with እርስዎ. The report itself is Chronicles' own wording.

decisions.choice: "आप", "आपके दास" (L), "आपके अधिकारी" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Shaphan speaks to the king with आप, as in 2 Kings 22:9.

decisions.choice: Shaphan reports to the king in です・ます, "あなたのしもべども" (L), "王さまの家臣たち" (B), "王さまの家来たち" (R), as 2 Kings 22:9.

decisions.choice: poured out the money: emptied the chest
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 22:9, the verb means to pour out, most likely emptying the money out of the chest (24:8-11) to be counted and paid out. The same verb is used of melting metal (Ezekiel 22:20-22), so it may mean that the silver was melted down.

decisions.choice: the report as in 2 Kings 22:9
decisions.reason: The words follow 2 Kings 22:9, which says "in the house" and gives the money to "the doers of the work, those appointed in the house of Yahweh". Chronicles says "in the house of Yahweh" and names the overseers and the workmen separately, as in verse 10.

decisions.choice: poured out / emptied out; those who are appointed / the overseers / the men in charge
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 22:9 where the Hebrew is the same. Shaphan's report closes here.

decisions.choice: derramaram (L), despejaram (B), tiraram da caixa (R)
decisions.reason: The verb keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 22:9 at each level (m1, m2), with Readable naming the money chest as there; Chronicles names the overseers and the workmen apart, as verse 10 does.

decisions.choice: The words of 2 Kings 22:9b ("አፈሰሱ", "አውጥተው"), with Chronicles' two groups: the overseers and the workmen.
decisions.reason: Kings has one group, "the doers of the work appointed over the house"; Chronicles names both.

ja.B: それから書記シャファンは王に告げた。「祭司ヒルキヤが、わたしに一つの書物を渡しました。」そしてシャファンは、それを王の前で読み上げた。
ja.R: 書記のシャファンは、王にこうも伝えました。「祭司ヒルキヤが、わたしに書物を渡しました。」そして、シャファンはそれを王の前で読み上げました。

uk.L: І розповів Шафан, писар, цареві, кажучи: «Книгу дав мені Хілкія, священник.» І читав з неї Шафан перед царем.
uk.B: Тоді писар Шафан сказав цареві: «Священник Хілкія передав мені книгу.» І Шафан читав з неї вголос перед царем.
uk.R: Писар Шафан також сказав цареві: «Священник Хілкія дав мені книгу.» Потім він прочитав з неї вголос цареві.

decisions.choice: a book: Shaphan names it without saying what it is
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 22:10, "a book" stands first in Shaphan's words, and he does not repeat Hilkiah's words "the book of the law" (verse 15).

decisions.choice: read in it before the king: read from it aloud
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 22:10 says that Shaphan "read it"; Chronicles says he "read in it", which may mean that he read parts of it. To read "before" someone is to read in his hearing (Deuteronomy 31:11).

decisions.choice: read from it; aloud
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 22:10, with "from it" for the Hebrew "in it" (m2). Balanced and Readable say "aloud" for what reading "before the king" means.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 22:10
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 2 Kings 22:10, so its Vietnamese is reused at each level.

decisions.choice: leu nele (L); leu trechos dele (B), leu partes do livro (R); em voz alta (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 22:10 in Portuguese, except that Chronicles says "read in it" (m2): Literal keeps "leu nele", and Balanced and Readable say he read parts of it, which is what "from it" means in the English; "em voz alta" says reading before the king, as there.

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 2 Kings 22:10, with "ከእርሱ አነበበ" / "ከመጽሐፉ … አነበበ" (read from it) for "read it".
decisions.reason: Chronicles says he read in the book, not the whole of it.

source.text: וַיְהִי֙ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֣י הַתּוֹרָ֑ה וַיִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת־בְּגָדָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was when heard the king the words of the law, and he tore his clothes.

en.L: And it was, when the king heard the words of the law, that he tore his clothes.
en.B: When the king heard the words of the law, he tore his clothes.
en.R: When the king heard the words of {{divine_name:the LORD's|Yahweh's}} teaching, he tore his clothes in grief.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando el rey oyó las palabras de la ley, rasgó sus vestidos.
es.B: Cuando el rey oyó las palabras de la ley, rasgó sus vestidos.
es.R: Cuando el rey oyó las palabras de la enseñanza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, rasgó su ropa en señal de dolor.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand le roi entendit les paroles de la Loi, qu’il déchira ses vêtements.
fr.B: Quand le roi entendit les paroles de la Loi, il déchira ses vêtements.
fr.R: Quand le roi a entendu les paroles de l’enseignement {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, il a déchiré ses vêtements de douleur.

sw.L: Ikawa mfalme alipoyasikia maneno ya Sheria, akayararua mavazi yake.
sw.B: Mfalme alipoyasikia maneno ya Sheria, aliyararua mavazi yake.
sw.R: Mfalme alipoyasikia maneno ya mafundisho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliyararua mavazi yake kwa huzuni.

vi.L: Xảy ra, khi vua nghe những lời của luật pháp, thì vua xé áo mình.
vi.B: Khi vua nghe những lời của luật pháp, vua xé áo mình.
vi.R: Khi vua nghe những lời dạy của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vua xé áo mình vì đau buồn.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 율법의 말씀을 들었을 때에 자기 옷을 찢었다.
ko.B: 왕은 율법의 말씀을 듣고 자기 옷을 찢었다.
ko.R: 왕은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침의 말씀을 듣고, 슬퍼하며 자기 옷을 찢었다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando o rei ouviu as palavras da Lei, rasgou as suas roupas.
pt.B: Quando o rei ouviu as palavras da Lei, rasgou as suas roupas.
pt.R: Quando o rei ouviu as palavras do ensino {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, rasgou as suas roupas em sinal de tristeza.

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ንጉሡ የሕጉን ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ ልብሱን ቀደደ።
am.B: ንጉሡ የሕጉን ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ ልብሱን ቀደደ።
am.R: ንጉሡ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትምህርት በሰማ ጊዜ በሐዘን ልብሱን ቀደደ።

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ कि जब राजा ने व्यवस्था की बातें सुनीं, तो उसने अपने कपड़े फाड़े।
hi.B: जब राजा ने व्यवस्था की बातें सुनीं, तो उसने अपने कपड़े फाड़े।
hi.R: जब राजा ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शिक्षा की बातें सुनीं, तो उसने दुःख के मारे अपने कपड़े फाड़े।

ru.L: И было, когда услышал царь слова закона, он разорвал свои одежды.
ru.B: Когда царь услышал слова закона, он разорвал свои одежды.
ru.R: Когда царь услышал слова учения {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, он разорвал свою одежду в знак скорби.

ja.L: そして王が律法の言葉を聞いたとき、彼は自分の衣を裂いた。
ja.B: 王は律法の言葉を聞くと、衣を裂いた。
ja.R: 王は、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の教えの言葉を聞くと、悲しんで自分の服を裂きました。

uk.L: І сталося, коли почув цар слова закону, то роздер свій одяг.
uk.B: Коли цар почув слова закону, він роздер свій одяг.
uk.R: Коли цар почув слова навчання {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}}, він роздер свій одяг на знак горя.

decisions.choice: he tore his clothes: a sign of grief and alarm
decisions.reason: Tearing one's clothes was the outward sign of grief, dismay or repentance (2 Kings 18:37; 19:1). The king sees that the words of the law stand against his people (verse 21).

decisions.choice: the words of the law: 2 Kings 22:11 says "the words of the book of the law"
decisions.reason: The verse is the same as 2 Kings 22:11 except that Chronicles says "the words of the law". The sense is the same: what the book taught and warned.

decisions.choice: the LORD's teaching; in grief (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says "teaching" for the law and adds whose it is, as in verse 14. It adds "in grief" to say what tearing the clothes meant (m1), as at 2 Kings 22:11.

decisions.choice: as palavras da Lei (L, B); as palavras do ensino do SENHOR (R)
alternatives: as palavras do Livro da Lei (as 2 Kings 22:11)
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 22:11 in Portuguese, with "as palavras da Lei" where Chronicles leaves out "the book" (m2); "Lei" keeps its capital as the law of Moses. Readable is the same as in Kings.

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 2 Kings 22:11 with "የሕጉን ቃል" (the words of the law) for "the words of the book of the law".
decisions.reason: Chronicles leaves out "the book".

source.text: וַיְצַ֣ו הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת־חִלְקִיָּ֡הוּ וְאֶת־אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן־שָׁ֠פָן וְאֶת־עַבְדּ֨וֹן בֶּן־מִיכָ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת׀שָׁפָ֣ן הַסּוֹפֵ֗ר וְאֵ֛ת עֲשָׂיָ֥ה עֶֽבֶד־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵאמֹֽר׃

es.L: Y el rey mandó a Hilcías, y a Ahicam hijo de Safán, y a Abdón hijo de Micá, y al escriba Safán, y a Asaías, siervo del rey, diciendo:
es.B: Entonces el rey dio órdenes a Hilcías, a Ahicam hijo de Safán, a Abdón hijo de Micá, al secretario Safán y a Asaías, funcionario del rey:
es.R: Entonces el rey les dio una orden a Hilcías, a Ahicam hijo de Safán, a Abdón hijo de Micá, al secretario Safán y a Asaías, un funcionario del rey. Les dijo:

fr.L: Et le roi donna cet ordre à Hilqiya, et à Ahiqam fils de Shaphân, et à Abdôn fils de Michée, et à Shaphân le scribe, et à Asaya, le serviteur du roi, en disant :
fr.B: Puis le roi donna cet ordre à Hilqiya, à Ahiqam, fils de Shaphân, à Abdôn, fils de Michée, à Shaphân, le secrétaire, et à Asaya, l’officier du roi :
fr.R: Ensuite le roi a donné un ordre à Hilqiya, à Ahiqam, fils de Shaphân, à Abdôn, fils de Michée, à Shaphân, le secrétaire, et à Asaya, un officier du roi. Il leur a dit :

sw.R: Kisha mfalme akatoa amri kwa Hilkia, Ahikamu mwana wa Shafani, Abdoni mwana wa Mika, Shafani katibu, na Asaya, afisa wa mfalme. Akasema,
